messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Hydroxyzine makes the effects of central nervous system depressants stronger. If you take hydroxyzine with any of the following, your doctor may need to lower the dose of the other medicine:
- narcotic (opioid) pain medicines
- non-narcotic pain medicines
- barbiturates
Hydroxyzine may increase the effects of meperidine and barbiturates when used before anesthesia, so your doctor will adjust these doses for you individually.
Care is needed if you take other medicines that can affect heart rhythm by prolonging the QT interval. These include:
- heart rhythm medicines such as quinidine, procainamide, amiodarone, and sotalol
- certain antipsychotics such as ziprasidone, iloperidone, clozapine, quetiapine, and chlorpromazine
- certain antidepressants such as citalopram and fluoxetine
- certain antibiotics such as azithromycin, erythromycin, clarithromycin, gatifloxacin, and moxifloxacin
- other medicines such as pentamidine, methadone, ondansetron, and droperidol
Triplet: ["hydroxyzine", "has interaction with", "droperidol"]

The relation 'has interaction with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug exhibits a pharmacological interaction with the specified medication or drug class.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. B. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
C. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
